gmcm.cleanup-days.name: Cleanup Interval (days)
gmcm.cleanup-days.tooltip: How often to clear uncollected spawned items from submaps. 0 = never auto-cleanup.
gmcm.progressive-unlock.name: Progressive Room Unlock
gmcm.progressive-unlock.tooltip: If enabled, submap doors unlock following vanilla Community Center progression (drink the Wizard's potion, then complete bundles). If disabled, all rooms are always open.
gmcm.general-dedup.name: Deduplicate General Pool
gmcm.general-dedup.tooltip: If enabled, an item appearing in multiple unmapped bundle rooms counts once in the General Room pool. If disabled, duplicates increase the item's spawn weight.
gmcm.spawn-count.name: Daily Spawn Count
gmcm.spawn-count.tooltip: How many ground forage items to spawn daily in {{locationName}}.
